title: Zesty Tender Russian Peas Stew
description: A rich, tender stew featuring frozen peas, roasted carrots and onions, and a bright lemon zing made in a tandoor, perfect for a paleo-friendly dinner.
instructions: Toss diced carrots and quartered onions with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, pepper, and cumin; spread on a metal tray and roast in the tandoor for 10 minutes until lightly charred.
While veggies roast, heat the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté minced garlic until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the roasted carrots, onions, and tomato paste to the pot, stirring to coat the vegetables and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Stir in frozen peas, lemon zest, and sea salt; cover and let simmer for 8 minutes until peas are tender and flavorful.
Add black pepper and dill, stirring gently, and simmer for another 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt or pepper if needed.
Ladle the stew into bowls and garnish with a sprinkle of fresh dill.
Serve hot with a side of fresh salad or crusty bread.
